analogy.rationale: VEGFR inhibitors block receptor tyrosine kinases (KDR, FLT1, FLT4) that are poorly expressed in most of these cell lines, so transcriptional responses should be weak; the closest reference classes are other angiogenesis/tyrosine-kinase inhibitors, while EGFR/PDGFR classes overlap only partially.
